headline: Bangladesh lose ODI series to Zimbabwe after 13-run defeat
summary: The Tigers suffer a back-to-back series loss in Zimbabwe, failing to chase 248 in the second match of the three-game series.
details: Bangladesh lost the second ODI in Harare by 13 runs, resulting in a series loss following a previous defeat in the Test series.
Zimbabwe posted 247 runs, with Ben Curran remaining unbeaten on 111. He became the ninth batter in ODI history to bat through all 50 overs.
Zimbabwe's innings was bolstered by a 99-run partnership between Ben Curran and Brad Evans, who scored 58 off 38 balls.
In response, Bangladesh struggled early, losing Soumya Sarkar (5) and Najmul Hossain Shanto (9) during the powerplay.
Tanjid Hasan Tamim provided some resistance with a half-century, but the Tigers were eventually bowled out for 234 runs.

Zimbabwe's innings was bolstered by a 99-run partnership between Ben Curran and Brad Evans, who scored 58 off 38 balls.

In response, Bangladesh struggled early, losing Soumya Sarkar (5) and Najmul Hossain Shanto (9) during the powerplay.

headline: Gold worth crores: Youth detained with gold bars at Khulna railway station
summary: Authorities have apprehended a man carrying gold bars valued at crores of taka at the Khulna railway station.
details: A youth was detained at the Khulna railway station after being found in possession of gold bars worth crores of taka.
The seizure occurred during a routine check at the station, where the suspect was intercepted by authorities.
The gold bars were recovered from the person of the suspect, highlighting a significant smuggling attempt.
Authorities are currently interrogating the detained youth to uncover the source of the gold and the wider smuggling network involved.
Further investigations are ongoing to identify any accomplices or the destination of the gold bars.
